findings.source: VRFCoordinatorV2: SubscriptionConfig memory subConfig = s_subscriptionConfigs[subId]; (copies address[] consumers to memory)
findings.issue: The compiler's storage-to-memory copy of the consumers array is a do-while: printed with its first element peeled and an end-pointer condition, it takes 9 lines for one array copy (and is followed in getSubscription by a second re-encoding loop).
findings.rule: As in c00041: a loop writing mem[d + 32k] = address(stor[base + k]) for k < len (first element peeled, condition d + 32 * len > p + 32) is the copy 'mem[d len 32 * len] = stor[base len len]'; fold the peeled iteration back.

findings.source: struct SubscriptionConfig { address owner; address requestedOwner; address[] consumers; } in mapping s_subscriptionConfigs
findings.issue: The array member consumers of the struct in a mapping has its length named (stor3[subId].field_512) but its elements are raw keccak arithmetic (the c00600 struct-member-mapping case, for an array).
findings.rule: sha3(sha3(k, s) + j) + i with constant j is element i of the dynamic array at member j of s[k]: print stor3[subId].field_512[i].
